statement: Warren 2026-10-07, listing quality (best version): (1) cross-retailer parity: the same product is compared across all retailers and the one behind is flagged; (2) floor: 6+ images, 150+ words description, key specs CPU/RAM/storage/screen/OS, title has brand + model; (3) specs that disagree with the product master are a core check; (4) every result shows snapshot age and stale is never a pass; (5) retailer-appropriate checks: buy box held by the retailer on marketplaces (Takealot, Amazon), listed/in stock/price on single-seller retailers; (6) quality shown beside that product's weekly sell-through at the same retailer, labelled as correlation. Rating/review count shown, zero reviews flagged. Failures are amber flags and never block; missing data is grey 'No data', never a failure. Search position per retailer site search as a second step with Warren's terms. SEO is no longer a non-goal (spec section 8 v0 note superseded).
